requirements.text: Visited links shall be recorded to the Global History.
The correct link shall be recorded to the Global History after a server redirect.
Clicking on a history link shall cause it to be launched in a browser window.
A History entry shall be deleted.
Multiple History entries shall be deleted and no longer be displayed.
History items shall be grouped by Day / Site / None.
History shall be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.
History columns shall be resizable to show/hide more of entries.
History colmns shall be shown and hidden.
Recently visited sites shall be re-visited via Back and Forward button dropdown menu.
A new, empty session history file shall be created for a new browser window or a restart.

generated_cases.title: Record standard visited link to Global History
generated_cases.description: Verify that when a user navigates to a standard HTTP/HTTPS web link, the visited link is successfully recorded in the Global History.

generated_cases.title: Exclude failed navigations from Global History
generated_cases.description: Verify that failed navigations such as connection timeouts or 404 error pages are not recorded as successfully visited links in the Global History.

generated_cases.title: Record Final Destination URL After Single Redirect
generated_cases.description: Navigate to a URL that issues a 301 or 302 redirect to a different target URL and verify that the final destination URL, rather than the intermediary URL, is recorded in the Global History.

generated_cases.title: Record Final Destination URL Across Redirect Chains
generated_cases.description: Navigate to a URL that triggers a multi-step redirect chain (e.g., A -> B -> C) and verify that the ultimate final destination URL (C) is correctly recorded in the Global History.

generated_cases.title: Handle Redirect Loops Without Corrupting History
generated_cases.description: Attempt to navigate to a URL that results in a server redirect loop, and ensure that the browser handles the error gracefully without recording invalid or looping history entries.

generated_cases.title: Launch History Link in Current Window
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link successfully launches the target URL in the current browser window.

generated_cases.title: Launch History Link with Modified Opening Action
generated_cases.description: Verify that opening a history link in a new tab or new window via modifier keys or context menu functions correctly.

generated_cases.title: Launch Invalid or Corrupted History Link
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to launch a corrupted or malformed URI stored in the history gracefully handles the error without crashing the browser.

generated_cases.title: Delete Single History Entry Successfully
generated_cases.description: Verify that selecting a single history entry and triggering deletion removes the entry from both the UI list and the underlying database.

generated_cases.title: Attempt Deletion of Non-Existent History Entry
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to delete a non-existent or already deleted history entry ID handles the operation gracefully without causing application errors.

generated_cases.title: Delete contiguous range of history entries
generated_cases.description: Select a continuous range of multiple history entries using Shift+Click, execute the delete action, and verify that all selected entries are removed from the view and database.

generated_cases.title: Delete discontiguous set of history entries
generated_cases.description: Select multiple non-contiguous history entries using Ctrl+Click, execute the delete action, and verify that all selected entries are successfully deleted and no longer displayed.

generated_cases.title: Attempt deletion with empty selection
generated_cases.description: Trigger the delete action when no history entries are selected and verify that the application handles the empty selection gracefully without errors.

generated_cases.title: Clear Entire Global History
generated_cases.description: Trigger the clear history function on a populated Global History database and verify that all entries are removed and the UI resets correctly.

generated_cases.title: Clear Empty Global History
generated_cases.description: Trigger the clear history function when the Global History is already empty and verify that the system handles the action gracefully without errors.

generated_cases.title: Group History by Day
generated_cases.description: Verify that history items are correctly grouped and displayed under day-based headers when the 'Day' grouping option is selected.

generated_cases.title: Group History by Site
generated_cases.description: Verify that history items are nested and categorized under respective site or domain headers when the 'Site' grouping option is selected.

generated_cases.title: Group History by None
generated_cases.description: Verify that history items are displayed in a flat, ungrouped list when the grouping option is set to 'None'.

generated_cases.title: Dynamic Grouping View Switching
generated_cases.description: Verify that the history view dynamically updates and re-organizes the displayed items seamlessly when switching between Day, Site, and None grouping views.

generated_cases.title: Sort and Reverse-Sort History Columns
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking history column headers (e.g., Title, URL, Last Visited) sorts the list in ascending order, and clicking again reverse-sorts the list in descending order.

generated_cases.title: Sorting Empty History List
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to sort columns when the history list is empty is handled gracefully without causing UI errors or crashes.

generated_cases.title: Resize history columns to show and hide more entry details
generated_cases.description: Verify that dragging the column border of a history list column expands or collapses its width properly, ensuring text truncation or expansion updates dynamically according to the new dimensions.

generated_cases.title: History column resizing boundary limits
generated_cases.description: Verify that history columns respect minimum and maximum width boundaries when dragged excessively, preventing total collapse or infinite expansion beyond the UI window bounds.

generated_cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns via Header Menu
generated_cases.description: Verify that history columns can be successfully shown and hidden using the column header context menu.

generated_cases.title: Prevent Hiding All History Columns
generated_cases.description: Verify that the user cannot hide all columns, ensuring at least a minimum number of visible columns remains.

generated_cases.title: Re-visit site via Back button dropdown menu
generated_cases.description: Navigate through multiple pages, long-click or hold the Back button to display the dropdown history menu, and select a previously visited page to verify successful navigation back to that site.

generated_cases.title: Re-visit site via Forward button dropdown menu
generated_cases.description: After navigating back from a history stack, long-click or hold the Forward button to display the dropdown menu of forward pages, and select a page to verify navigation to that site.

generated_cases.title: Back and Forward dropdown state at session start
generated_cases.description: Open a new browser window or tab where the navigation history stack is empty, and verify that the Back and Forward button dropdown menus are either disabled or empty.

generated_cases.title: Create Empty Session History File for New Browser Window
generated_cases.description: Verify that launching a brand new browser window initializes a fresh, empty session history file.

generated_cases.title: Create Empty Session History File on Browser Restart
generated_cases.description: Verify that restarting the browser without session restore initializes a new, empty session history file.

reference_cases.title: TC-073
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Observe the contents of the Global History Window.
3. Quit and restart the browser.
4. Select Go|History.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. If you've observed the initial conditions, the History window should be non-empty upon first observation.
2. After restart, the History window should still be non-empty.

reference_cases.title: TC-076
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Select (highlight) a history entry, press the delete key, OR
3. Select (highlight) a history entry, Select Edit|Delete.
4. Restart the browser.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. After step(3) the title of and link to the history entry should now be removed from the history window.
2. After step(4) it should still be gone.

reference_cases.title: TC-077

4. Restart the browser. Select Go|History

2. After step(4) they should still be gone.

reference_cases.title: TC-078
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Observe the contents of the Global History Window.
3. Select Edit|Preferences (from a navigator window)
4. Browse to the Navigator|History Panel.
5. Under "Browsing History" click the "Clear History" button.
6. Return to observe the contents of the Global History Window.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. If you've observed the initial conditions, the History window should be non-empty upon first observation.
2. After pressing the button, the history window should be empty of individual history items.

reference_cases.title: TC-079
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. In the Global History window, select View|Group By|Day.
3. In the Global History window, select View|Group By|Site.
4. In the Global History window, select View|Group By|None.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. After Step(2), history entries should appear grouped into folders labeled "Today", "Yesterday", "2 days ago", ... ,"6 days ago", and "Older than 6 days".
2. After Step(3), the history items should appear grouped by domain name (no folders).
3. After Sep (4), the history items should appear

reference_cases.title: TC-080
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
Select Go|History. This is most easily tested by using the View|Group By|None setting but not strictly necessary.
1. Click on the "Title" column once.
2. Click on the "Title" column a second time.
3. Click on the "Title" column a third time.
4. Click on the "Location" column once, and a second time.
5. Click on the "Last Visited" column once, and a second time.

EXPECTED RESULTS
By step:
1. The bookmarks should sort into alphabetical order, by Title.
2. The bookmarks should sort into reverse-alphabetical order, by Title.
3. The bookmarks should sort into "natural" order (the way they were originally sorted).
4. The bookmarks should sort into order by Location and then the reverse of that order.
5. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Visited and then the reverse of that order.

reference_cases.title: TC-081
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Mouseover the separator between the "Name" and "URL" columns.
3. Click and drag that separator to the left and right.
4. Repeat this with each of the other column separators.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. In step(2) the mouse pointer should change to a double-arrowed icon(platform specific or XP?).
2. In step(3) the column sizes on either side of the separator should shrink and grow as you drag. The content of the column should move with the column header. Column content that is obscured should be replaced by the ellipsis(?).

reference_cases.title: TC-082
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Click the icon on the far right of the column headers.
3. Uncheck two of the items (columns).
4. Recheck an item.
5. Quit and restart the application.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. Step(2) a popup menu should appear listing all of the column headers as menuitems.
2. Step(3), they should all be checked by default and unchecking should cause that column to disappear from the manage bookmarks window.
3. Step(4), the columns should reappear upon rechecking its name on the list.
4. Step(5) the columns should appear just as the did after step(4).

reference_cases.title: TC-083
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. Your session history needs to be empty for this test so restart the browser or open a new window. To check, the Back/Forward buttons should be inactive and the dropdowns should not appear at all when the session history is empty.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Follow this Netscape link.
2. Follow this Netscape People link.
3. Wait for the redirect (15sec).
4. Follow this Mozilla QA link.
5. Follow this Mozilla link.
6. From the "Back" button dropdown select the 4th item from the top "Netscape.com".
7. From the "Forward" button dropdown select the 3rd item from the top "Mozilla QA Home Page"

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. For Step(6), the dropdown menu should be apparent and active, the 4th item should be "Netscape.com", the page title, and selecting it should actually load that page
2. For Step(7), the dropdown menu should be apparent and active, the 3rd item should be "Mozilla QA Home Page", the page title, and selecting it should actually load that page.
